messages:
elaine_support: FYI — customer ACME hitting a regression after last night's canary (v2026.03.1). They say tiny prompt-template changes (even a single space) now break structured output. Repro steps + payload below. cc @sam_ml @jordan_pm

maria_customer: unblocked a quick screen grab — we used to get a JSON blob back, now the model returns plain text and misses keys. super small change: added a space after 'Name:'.

noah_support: request-id and sample please. Any 4xx/5xx or is this purely quality?

elaine_support: no HTTP errors. latency normal. customer provided this minimal repro.

elaine_support: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACMEEXAMPLE" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"Extract: Name:Alice\nAge:30\nReturn as JSON with fields name, age.","max_tokens":200}'
```

elaine_support: response (old model / pinned) -> `{ "name": "Alice", "age": 30 }`

elaine_support: same request but template modified with an extra space after colon in 'Name: Alice' (customer said they only added that space):

elaine_support: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACMEEXAMPLE" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","prompt":"Extract: Name: Alice\nAge:30\nReturn as JSON with fields name, age.","max_tokens":200}'
```

elaine_support: response (canary v2026.03.1) -> `Name Alice is 30 years old.` (no JSON, free-form text)

sam_ml: interesting — no API errors, latency normal, and pinning to v2026.02.9 makes the problem go away? can you confirm pinned results match customer's old behavior?

elaine_support: confirmed: pinned to v2026.02.9 -> correct JSON. Canary to 5% last night -> break observed.

jordan_pm: deploy-bot, can you paste the rollout metadata?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: artifact redwood-inference@v2026.03.1, rollout=5%, started=2026-03-12T02:15:03Z, completed-to-canary=2026-03-12T02:20:12Z, canary-tag=canary-20260312-1

noah_support: customer asks for workaround now. short-term we can advise them to normalize templates (remove optional spaces) or include an explicit JSON schema in the prompt. But we need a root cause and a mitigation from infra/ML.

sam_ml: hypothesis: a tokenizer normalization or whitespace-handling tweak in the new runtime path changed how the model conditions on punctuation/spacing — that can flip generation from "strict JSON" to freeform. I'll run token diffs between v2026.02.9 and v2026.03.1 for the two prompts (with/without space) and surface logits around the first output token.

sam_ml: quick test commands I will run (local):
```python
# pseudo
old_tokens = tokenize(prompt_old, model='v2026.02.9')
new_tokens = tokenize(prompt_old, model='v2026.03.1')
# compare token ids and lengths, then compare top-k logits for next token
```

elaine_support: customer provided an example request-id: req_20260312_9f3b. Attached their raw request and response in the support ticket. I put everything into ticket #8471.

noah_support: there's also a related support thread from another customer in EU that reported similar sensitivity after the same canary — may be systemic.

jordan_pm: priority: P1 for customer-facing quality regression. Next steps: (1) sam_ml run token/logit diffs and try to reproduce locally end-to-end; (2) eng-runtime check if any tokenization/normalization changes shipped in v2026.03.1; (3) support provide customer rollback option or mitigation (pin to v2026.02.9 or normalize inputs).

sam_ml: will start on (1) now. preliminary guess: a whitespace normalization in our preprocessing merged two tokens and changed the model's conditioning. If confirmed, mitigation could be a quick revert or a runtime toggle for legacy tokenization until a proper fix ships.

elaine_support: I told customer we can pin them to older model now and we're investigating. They asked for ETA on fix — please keep me posted. :eyes: :pray:

deploy-bot: Rollout note: v2026.03.1 included kernel selection optimizations and a tokenization lib bump (tokenizer-lib@1.14.0 -> 1.15.0).

sam_ml: bingo — tokenizer-lib bump flagged. tagging eng-runtime. I'll attach token diffs and logits to the ticket and paste results here when done.

noah_support: if eng-runtime can confirm the tokenizer change is the cause, recommend rolling back that bump from production canary and halt further rollout. customer impact is high for structured extraction templates.

elaine_support: creating an interim KB entry with mitigation steps (pin to older model, normalize whitespace, add explicit JSON wrapper in prompt). Saving logs to ticket #8471.

jordan_pm: thanks all — please update ticket and add postmortem if rollback or fix happens. I'll coordinate with account team for ACME notice.

sam_ml: initial token diff: prompt without space -> tokens: [..., 345, 98, 12], with space -> tokens: [..., 345, 78, 12] — small shift but next-token logits diverge significantly. Dropping findings in #8471.

elaine_support: noted. I'll keep customer updated.
